Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed two distinct proteomics analyses: an AR interactome (affinity-purified) and a whole proteome analysis. Since the 'whole proteome' analysis is explicitly described as using 'whole cell lysates' and is a primary component of the MS data (PXD029525), the scope is labeled as whole cell lysate. The AR IP (PXD029249) represents a sub-analysis of purified complexes.
